messages.content: What is the time now in New York City?

function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time clocks or external services, so I can’t tell you the exact current time right now.  
To find out what time it’s currently in New York City (Eastern Time), you could:

* Check your phone or computer’s world‑clock feature set to “New York” / Eastern Standard/Daylight Time.
* Look up “current time in New York” on a search engine or use an online world‑clock website such as [worldtimeserver.com](https://www.worldtimeserver.com/) or [timeanddate.com](https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/new-york).
* Ask a smart assistant (Google Assistant, Siri, Alexa) if you’re near one.

Those sources will give you the precise local time at this moment.
message.reasoning: User asks current time in NYC. We need real-time info; we can't fetch live data. According to policy, cannot provide inaccurate or guess. Should respond with limitation. Possibly suggest using reliable source like world clock. So answer explaining inability.
